daily.today_energy: Mars is literally in your sign right now, so you're running on pure confidence and drive. The Sun squaring Mars might make you feel a little restless, but that's just your Leo fire wanting to do everything at once. Channel it into something that matters.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is working hard for your relationships today. If you're coupled up, there's real warmth and generosity flowing between you two. Single? Your natural magnetism is turned up. Keep it real though—no need to oversell yourself.
daily.career: Mars in Leo paired with Jupiter means you've got momentum on your side. This is your moment to pitch ideas or take on leadership. Just watch the Sun-Mars square—don't let impatience make you skip important details. Slow down slightly to avoid friction.
daily.health: You've got energy for days, but Saturn retrograde is whispering to pace yourself. Great day for hitting the gym or trying something new, but listen to your body if it asks for rest. Balance intensity with recovery.

Watch-Out Day: Thursday when Mars shifts into Virgo, pulling some of that fire inward. The Moon hits your sign midweek for an emotional reset. This is about channeling intensity into something real, not just vibes.
weekly.love: Early week is *the* window for bold moves—Mars-Jupiter has you magnetic and magnetic energy is attractive. Midweek, the Leo Moon softens things; lean into vulnerability if you're coupled up. By weekend, Mars dips into Virgo, so the flirtation phase ends and you'll want actual substance. Quality over quantity, babe.
weekly.career: Tuesday is your power day—Mars conjunct Jupiter hands you ambition on a platter. Use it to pitch ideas, ask for that raise, or take charge of a project. Midweek feels dreamy but productive; the Moon in your sign sharpens your instincts. Thursday onwards, Mars in Virgo shifts you into execution mode—time to actually *do* the work, not just plan it.
weekly.health: Your energy is HIGH early week (Mars-Jupiter), so channel it into workouts or movement you actually enjoy. Midweek might feel emotionally intense—journal it out. By Thursday, Mars into Virgo asks for routine and discipline. This isn't burnout; it's about building sustainable habits that stick.
